challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Gulf Arabic conversation that lasts at least 10 lines about your work or studies and your plans for the future. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 8 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about profession using شنو تشتغل or شنو تشتغلين.
An answer naming a job or field of study.
A question about where someone works or studies using وين.
A mention of years of experience or year of study using سنة or سنين.
A future plan using أبي or ناوي or بـ.
A mention of an ambition or dream using طموحي or حلمي.
The phrase إن شاء الله after a future plan.
A closing exchange such as الله يوفقك or ولا يهمك.

dialogue.transliteration: Tumoo7i aSeer mudeer far3 yoom min il-ayyaam.
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a branch manager one day.

dialogue.speaker: Lateefa
dialogue.arabic: حلو واجد، وأنا أبي أكمل دراستي ماجستير في القانون.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ilu waajid, w ana abi akammil diraasti maajistair fil qaanoon.
dialogue.english: Very nice, and I want to continue my studies for a master's in law.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقچ، أكيد بتوصلين.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ywaffigich, akeed bitooSaleen.
dialogue.english: God grant you success, you'll definitely get there.

dialogue.speaker: Lateefa
dialogue.arabic: الله يسلمك، وياليت توصل لهدفك بعد.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ysalimak, w yaalait tooSal lihadafak ba3ad.
dialogue.english: God keep you, and I hope you reach your goal too.
